name: Rapid Shifting (Shifting)
body:
Prerequisite(s): 1 or more Shifting feats
Benefit: You may always shift as a free action on your turn.

Special: At 3 Shifting feats, you may shift as an immediate action.

At 5 Shifting feats, you can shift as a free action, even when it isn’t your turn. You may still not shift if you are flat-footed. This feat modifies the actions required to shift, and is active even when you are not shifted.
